stories.title: The Glowing Leaf Trail

stories.title: Sunny and the Riddle Lock

stories.title: Prickle Learns to Share

scenes.text: A thirsty lizard stopped, panting. Four quail watched from a shade bush. Prickle's spines trembled, but he tipped his cup toward the lizard anyway. The lizard drank carefully and smiled, leaving a cool pebble as thanks.

scenes.imagePrompt: Cactus with pink flower surrounded by rabbit friends and lizard bringing shade cloth, early morning soft light, happy welcoming mood, dew on leaves, desert porch scene, cozy colors.

stories.title: Teeny's Special Sound

scenes.text: He practiced behind boulders, puffing his cheeks and flapping his wings. Four sparrows perched nearby, listening. Each roar became a different sound: chirp, hum, and drum. Teeny noticed the hum made flowers sway in time.

scenes.text: At the meadow, Teeny hummed again, and fireflies blinked along the rhythm. Three rabbits clapped their paws. Teeny realized his talent was not roaring loud; it was making music with his breath, bright and gentle.
scenes.imagePrompt: Tiny teal dragon hums musically in meadow, fireflies blinking to rhythm, warm sunset glow, joyful discovery mood, rabbits clapping, gentle magical atmosphere, soft watercolor storybook style.

stories.title: Kobi's Forest Lullaby
